SUBJECT: AR253 SITE PLANNING AND LANDSCAPE ARCHITECTURE
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates

   CO BL
Q.1(a) What is a retaining wall? [2] 2 1
Q.1(b) What are the two main types of retaining wall? Explain with diagrams. [3] 2 2


Q.2(a) What is an edge condition? [2] 1 2
Q.2(b) With  the  help  of  a  diagram, explain  the  difference  between  an  open-trough  and
concealed-trough edge in a pool.
[3] 1 3


Q.3(a) What are the different parameters of softscape used for planting design? [2] 3 1
Q.3(b) How does scale function as a parameter for choosing species for planting design? [3] 3 4


Q.4(a) Which  properties  determine  the  visual  texture  of  a  plant?  Explain  with  conceptual
diagrams.
[2] 2 2
Q.4(b) Explain  with  conceptual  diagrams,  how  texture  functions  as  a  relative parameter  in
planting design.
[3] 1 4


Q.5(a) How are plants used for creating and altering microclimates? [2] 2 4
Q.5(b) Explain  with  schematic  sections,  how  choice  of  plants  influences  visual  and  physical
screening in a landscape design.
[3] 1 5
